rationale: Raised steady-state authority and enabled adaptation: UMAX 0.60->0.78, I_AUTH 0.15->0.40, E_GATE 0.10->0.25, KP 0.60->0.70, KI 0.007->0.015 with conditional anti-windup integration plus high-y freeze/derate. Nominal feedforward (0.15/1.08) kept as starting point; enlarged integral now learns +0.24 needed for new plant. Widened gate allows integration at post-change residual error ~0.12 that was previously frozen, while still freezing cold-start error >0.25 to avoid windup. High-y guard prevents soft/hard limit breach with larger UMAX.

extra.machine_card: Heater y in [0,1], u in [0,1]. Nominal: y_ss~0.15+1.08*u, tau~170s, lag ~20-30s, u_ss(0.5)~0.32. Changed: y_ss~0.095+0.71*u, tau~120-130s, lag ~20-30s unchanged, u_ss(0.5)~0.57. Noise ~0.01 plus down outliers. Limits: keep y<0.85 soft, y>=0.90 forces u=0.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal: rise in ~150-200s, small overshoot <0.56, MAE ~0.01-0.015, in-band >0.85, u steady ~0.30-0.33. Changed: rise slower but reaches 0.5 in ~200-280s, no steady offset, MAE ~0.015-0.025, in-band >0.80, u steady ~0.55-0.60, no hard violations or overrides. Integral learns +0.24 bias; P handles transient.
extra.diagnosis: Outflow/in-loss increase, not weaker heater or sensor or delay. E11 (u=0 from 0.393 settled 0.095) vs E2 (u=0 from 0.544 settled ~0.158, still falling) shows same shape but faster decay and lower ambient: tau ~170-185s before vs ~122-145s after, ambient 0.15->0.095. E9/E10: u=0.40 settles 0.33 then 0.383, slope ~0, so y_ss(0.40)~0.37-0.39 vs nominal 0.15+1.08*0.40=0.58. Implied K=(0.383-0.095)/0.40~0.72 vs 1.08 before (-33%). Loss a=1/tau 0.0059->0.0080 (+36%) while heating b=K/tau 0.0064->0.0057 (~-10% unchanged), so actuator similar but leak larger. Delay unchanged ~20-30s (E9 rises within 15-30s), ruling out response_slower; ambient + gain both down but decay faster rules out pure sensor_changed and pure actuator_weaker which would keep tau unchanged. New u_ss(0.5)=(0.5-0.095)/0.72~0.56-0.59 vs old 0.31-0.33.
